title: KIRA: A Full-Stack Reading Screening System with Dual-Pathway Analysis for Children
abstract: arXiv:2610.28840v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Early-grade reading screening is critical for identifying children at risk of reading difficulty. Existing AI-based screeners are often limited in the scope of their analyses and evaluation metrics, or are proprietary systems that lack transparent model specifications and evaluation. We present KIRA, a dual-pathway screening system that pairs word-level fluency scoring with detailed phoneme-level error detection. We adapt pretrained word and phoneme recognizers to children's speech, reducing word error rate from 13.88% to 8.84% and phoneme error rate from 41.66% to 23.00%. Powered by these child-adapted models, we implement Word Reading (WRE) and Oral Reading Fluency (ORF), two foundational tasks in K-2 screening. The system integrates these recognizers with a web-based teacher-facing interface presenting fluency scores alongside phoneme feedback for potential targeted intervention. translated_title: KIRA：面向儿童的双通道分析全栈阅读筛查系统
translated_abstract: 早期年级的阅读筛查对于识别存在阅读困难风险的儿童至关重要。现有的基于AI的筛查系统往往在分析范围和评估指标上存在局限，或者是一些缺乏透明模型规格与评估的专有系统。我们提出了KIRA，一个将单词级流畅度评分与详细的音素级错误检测相结合的双通道筛查系统。我们将预训练的单词和音素识别器适配到儿童语音上，将单词错误率从13.88%降低到8.84%，音素错误率从41.66%降低到23.00%。基于这些针对儿童适配的模型，我们实现了单词阅读（WRE）和口头阅读流畅度（ORF）这两项K-2年级筛查中的基础任务。该系统将这些识别器与面向教师的网页界面集成，呈现流畅度分数以及音素反馈，以便进行潜在的针对性干预。KIRA将现代儿童语音识别技术引入到一个全栈……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: KIRA是一个面向儿童的双通道阅读筛查系统，通过将预训练语音识别模型适配儿童语音（词错误率从13.88%降至8.84%，音素错误率从41.66%降至23.00%），实现了单词级流畅度评分与音素级错误检测的结合，并通过教师界面支持针对性阅读干预。
en_tdlr: KIRA is a dual-pathway reading screening system that adapts pretrained speech recognizers to children's speech—reducing word error rate to 8.84% and phoneme error rate to 23.00%—and combines word-level fluency scoring with phoneme-level error detection to support targeted early reading intervention.
